references.context: Choice of one measurable event in the common sigma algebra for every index i in arbitrary index set I.
Finite collection of distinct indices from the possibly infinite index set I.
Event shared by all A_j for indices j in J, equal to Omega for J empty.
Product of real numbers P(A_j) over the finite set J, interpreted as one if J empty.

references.disposition: For three or more events every finite joint intersection must satisfy product identity, not only pairs.

review_rationale: Reviewed mutual independence for arbitrary indexed family of events using every finite index subset, including singleton and empty-index product conventions, not merely pairwise tests.
